chapters.label: Turin, live
chapters.text: Turin, Champions League. Juventus, in black, play Dortmund, in yellow. Kenan Yıldız gets the ball on the left edge of the box. He steadies himself, and bends it with his right foot. Far corner! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. His right foot wraps around the ball. It starts wide of the far post, then bends back in.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: past the keeper, top corner! The fans roar!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How he does it: run at your defender. Your turn: face your defender, fake one way, and cut inside to shoot.
